code:
trips.filter(col("passenger_count").isNull()).show(5)
trips.filter(col("passenger_count").isNotNull()).show(5)

# WRONG -- does not find nulls:
trips.filter(col("passenger_count") == None)
caption: SQL's three-valued logic means == None doesn't work. isNull()/isNotNull() do.

code:
clean = trips.na.drop()                          # ANY column null
clean = trips.na.drop(subset=["passenger_count"]) # only THIS column
caption: Dropping on any null is often too aggressive — subset= narrows it.

code:
filled = trips.na.fill(0, subset=["passenger_count"])
filled = trips.na.fill("Unknown", subset=["store_and_fwd_flag"])
caption: A default value per column — only replaces nulls in the given subset.
